auth.authorize.approve.description: Button on the authorization (consent) page that lets the application use the account.

auth.authorize.caution.dm.description: Caution on a permission on the consent page: the application can read direct messages.

auth.authorize.caution.post.defaultMessage: Puede publicar, editar y eliminar publicaciones en tu nombre
auth.authorize.caution.post.description: Caution on a permission on the consent page: the application can post, edit or delete posts as the user.

auth.authorize.caution.profile.description: Caution on a permission on the consent page: the application can change the user's profile.

auth.authorize.deny.description: Button on the authorization (consent) page that refuses the application.

auth.authorize.group.defaultMessage: {risk, select, caution {Permisos que requieren tu atención} write {Permisos que cambian cosas} other {Permisos de solo lectura}}
auth.authorize.group.description: Heading on the consent page over the requested permissions of one weight: {risk} is caution (permissions that read direct messages, act as the user, or administer the server), write (permissions that change something), or read (permissions that only read).

auth.authorize.impersonation.defaultMessage: Después de permitirlo, la respuesta se enviará a {target}, que también pueden reclamar otras aplicaciones de tu dispositivo. Puede ser una aplicación distinta de la indicada arriba. Permítelo solo si iniciaste esto desde esa aplicación.
auth.authorize.impersonation.description: Warning on the consent page when the application is sent back to a loopback address or a custom URL scheme, which any app on the device can claim. {target} is that host or scheme.

auth.authorize.invalid.defaultMessage: La solicitud de autorización de esta aplicación no es válida. Ponte en contacto con el desarrollador de la aplicación.
auth.authorize.invalid.description: Error page (HTTP 400) when an application opened the authorization page with an unknown client or an unregistered redirect address.

auth.authorize.lead.defaultMessage: {app} quiere usar tu cuenta con estos permisos:
auth.authorize.lead.description: Introduces the list of permissions on the authorization (consent) page. {app} is the application's name.

auth.authorize.origin.dynamic.defaultMessage: Una aplicación que se registró por sí misma, con datos que declaró ella misma
auth.authorize.origin.dynamic.description: Where the application comes from, on the consent page, for an application that registered itself by dynamic client registration.

auth.authorize.origin.metadata_document.description: Where the application comes from, on the consent page, for an application identified by a client ID URL. {host} is that URL's host name, which the server verified.

auth.authorize.origin.user.description: Where the application comes from, on the consent page, for an application a user of this server registered. {owner} is that user's handle.

auth.authorize.origin.user_unknown.defaultMessage: Una aplicación registrada por un usuario de este servidor
auth.authorize.origin.user_unknown.description: Where the application comes from, on the consent page, for an application a user of this server registered when the user cannot be named.

auth.authorize.rate_limited.defaultMessage: Se han hecho demasiadas solicitudes de autorización para esta aplicación. Espera un poco e inténtalo de nuevo.
auth.authorize.rate_limited.description: Error page (HTTP 429) when the authorization page could not fetch a client's metadata document because its fetch limits are used up.

auth.authorize.redirect_notice.description: Note under the permissions on the authorization (consent) page. {host} is the host name the application receives the answer at.

auth.authorize.scope.admin.defaultMessage: Administrar la instancia, dentro de lo que permitan tus roles
auth.authorize.scope.admin.description: Permission (OAuth scope admin) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.admin_read.defaultMessage: Leer los datos de administración de la instancia, dentro de lo que permitan tus roles
auth.authorize.scope.admin_read.description: Permission (OAuth scope admin:read) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.admin_write.defaultMessage: Cambiar los datos de administración de la instancia, dentro de lo que permitan tus roles
auth.authorize.scope.admin_write.description: Permission (OAuth scope admin:write) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.follow.description: Permission (OAuth scope follow) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.push.description: Permission (OAuth scope push) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read.defaultMessage: Leer tu cuenta, tus publicaciones y tus líneas de tiempo
auth.authorize.scope.read.description: Permission (OAuth scope read) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_accounts.defaultMessage: Leer cuentas, tu perfil y tu configuración
auth.authorize.scope.read_accounts.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:accounts) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_blocks.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:blocks) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_bookmarks.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:bookmarks) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_custom_emojis.defaultMessage: Leer los emojis personalizados que creaste y tus solicitudes de nuevos
auth.authorize.scope.read_custom_emojis.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:custom_emojis) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_direct.defaultMessage: Leer los mensajes directos que envías y recibes
auth.authorize.scope.read_direct.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:direct) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_finance.defaultMessage: Leer los totales de los costos e ingresos de la instancia, dentro de lo que permitan tus roles
auth.authorize.scope.read_finance.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:finance) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_follows.defaultMessage: Leer tus seguidos, solicitudes de seguimiento, listas y las cuentas cuyas publicaciones nuevas te notifican
auth.authorize.scope.read_follows.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:follows) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_mutes.defaultMessage: Leer las cuentas y los dominios que silencias
auth.authorize.scope.read_mutes.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:mutes) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_notifications.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:notifications) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_reports.defaultMessage: Leer las denuncias que presentaste y si están resueltas
auth.authorize.scope.read_reports.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:reports) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_statuses.defaultMessage: Leer publicaciones y líneas de tiempo
auth.authorize.scope.read_statuses.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:statuses) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_supporters.defaultMessage: Leer tu suscripción a los planes de apoyo
auth.authorize.scope.read_supporters.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:supporters) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write.defaultMessage: Publicar y cambiar cosas en tu nombre
auth.authorize.scope.write.description: Permission (OAuth scope write) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_accounts.defaultMessage: Cambiar tu perfil y tu configuración
auth.authorize.scope.write_accounts.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:accounts) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_blocks.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:blocks) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_bookmarks.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:bookmarks) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_custom_emojis.defaultMessage: Solicitar emojis personalizados nuevos y cambiar o eliminar los que creaste
auth.authorize.scope.write_custom_emojis.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:custom_emojis) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_favourites.defaultMessage: Añadir y quitar favoritos y reacciones con emoji
auth.authorize.scope.write_favourites.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:favourites) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_follows.defaultMessage: Seguir y dejar de seguir cuentas, responder a solicitudes de seguimiento, cambiar listas y suscribirte a las publicaciones nuevas de cuentas
auth.authorize.scope.write_follows.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:follows) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_media.defaultMessage: Subir imágenes y editar sus descripciones
auth.authorize.scope.write_media.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:media) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_mutes.defaultMessage: Silenciar y dejar de silenciar cuentas y dominios
auth.authorize.scope.write_mutes.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:mutes) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_notifications.defaultMessage: Marcar notificaciones como leídas y descartarlas
auth.authorize.scope.write_notifications.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:notifications) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_reports.defaultMessage: Denunciar cuentas y publicaciones a los moderadores
auth.authorize.scope.write_reports.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:reports) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_statuses.defaultMessage: Publicar, editar, eliminar, impulsar y fijar publicaciones, votar en encuestas y definir quién puede citar una publicación
auth.authorize.scope.write_statuses.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:statuses) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_supporters.defaultMessage: Suscribirte a los planes de apoyo y cambiar, cancelar y reanudar tu suscripción
auth.authorize.scope.write_supporters.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:supporters) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.title.description: Title and heading of the authorization (consent) page. {app} is the name of the application asking for access.

auth.authorize.unverified.defaultMessage: Este servidor no ha verificado esta aplicación. Su nombre es una afirmación de la propia aplicación.
auth.authorize.unverified.description: Note on the authorization (consent) page of a third-party application: this server has not checked it; the name and logo are the application's own claim.

auth.authorize.website.description: The application's own home page on the consent page. {url} is the address the application declared.

auth.cross_origin.defaultMessage: Se rechazó la solicitud porque procedía de otro sitio.
auth.cross_origin.description: Body of the page shown (HTTP 403) when a sign-in or sign-out form was submitted from another origin.

auth.document.footer_label.description: Accessible name of the navigation in the footer of the server-rendered pages that links to the terms of service and the privacy policy.

auth.document.privacy_title.description: Title and heading of the public page of the instance's privacy policy, and the text of links to it.

auth.document.terms_title.description: Title and heading of the public page of the instance's terms of service, and the text of links to it.

auth.document_title.description: The browser tab title of the sign-in, sign-up, email verification, account status and consent pages: the page's title, then the server's name. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

auth.error.title.description: Title and heading of the sign-in screens' error pages.

auth.forgot_password.email_label.description: Label of the email address field of the form that asks for a password reset link.

auth.forgot_password.invalid_email.description: Error of the form that asks for a password reset link when the email address field is empty or not an email address.

auth.forgot_password.prompt.defaultMessage: Introduce el correo electrónico de tu cuenta. Te enviaremos un enlace para establecer una contraseña nueva.
auth.forgot_password.prompt.description: Text above the form that asks for a password reset link.

auth.forgot_password.rate_limited.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {Demasiadas solicitudes desde tu red. Inténtalo de nuevo dentro de # minuto.} other {Demasiadas solicitudes desde tu red. Inténtalo de nuevo dentro de # minutos.}}
auth.forgot_password.rate_limited.description: Error (HTTP 429) after too many requests for a password reset link from the same network. {minutes} is the wait, rounded up to whole minutes.

auth.forgot_password.sent.defaultMessage: Si alguna cuenta usa {email}, va en camino un enlace para establecer una contraseña nueva. {minutes, plural, one {El enlace funciona durante # minuto.} other {El enlace funciona durante # minutos.}} Si no llega ningún correo, revisa la carpeta de spam y la dirección.
auth.forgot_password.sent.description: Notice after a password reset link was asked for. It must read the same whether or not an account uses the address. {email} is the address the user entered; {minutes} how long the link works.

auth.forgot_password.submit.description: Button that asks for a password reset link by email.

auth.forgot_password.title.description: Title and heading of the page that asks for a password reset link.

auth.forgot_password.unavailable.defaultMessage: Este servidor no envía correo electrónico, así que no puede enviarte un enlace. Pide a los administradores del servidor un enlace para establecer una contraseña nueva.
auth.forgot_password.unavailable.description: Text of the page that asks for a password reset link on a server that sends no email; an administrator can issue the link.

auth.form_expired.defaultMessage: Este formulario ha caducado. Inténtalo de nuevo.
auth.form_expired.description: Error on the sign-in screens (HTTP 403) when the form's anti-forgery token is missing or does not match, e.g. after cookies were cleared.

auth.human_check.failed.defaultMessage: Completa la comprobación de que no eres un bot e inténtalo de nuevo.
auth.human_check.failed.description: Error (HTTP 422) on the sign-in and registration forms when the CAPTCHA check was missing, invalid, or expired.

auth.human_check.noscript.defaultMessage: Esta página comprueba que no eres un bot, y para ello necesita JavaScript. Activa JavaScript para continuar.
auth.human_check.noscript.description: Shown on the sign-in and registration forms when the browser runs no JavaScript, which the CAPTCHA widget needs.

auth.human_check.notice.defaultMessage: Esta página usa {service} para comprobar que no eres un bot. {service} recibe tu dirección IP e información sobre tu navegador.
auth.human_check.notice.description: Notice next to the CAPTCHA widget on the sign-in and registration forms, followed by links to the service's privacy policy. {service} is the service's name, such as Cloudflare Turnstile or hCaptcha.

auth.human_check.notice_recaptcha.defaultMessage: Este sitio está protegido por reCAPTCHA y se aplican la política de privacidad y los términos del servicio de Google. Google recibe tu dirección IP e información sobre tu navegador.
auth.human_check.notice_recaptcha.description: Notice next to the reCAPTCHA widget on the sign-in and registration forms, followed by links to Google's privacy policy and terms. Keep the names reCAPTCHA and Google: Google asks sites to show this statement.

auth.human_check.privacy_link.description: Link next to the CAPTCHA widget to the privacy policy of the company that runs the service. {owner} is a name such as Cloudflare, hCaptcha, or Google.

auth.human_check.terms_link.description: Link next to the CAPTCHA widget to the terms of the company that runs the service. {owner} is a name such as hCaptcha or Google.

auth.human_check.unavailable.defaultMessage: La comprobación de que no eres un bot no está disponible ahora. Inténtalo más tarde.
auth.human_check.unavailable.description: Error (HTTP 503) on the registration form when the CAPTCHA service cannot be reached; the account is not created.

auth.link.new_tab.description: Text that only assistive technology reads, after the name of a link on the sign-in and registration pages that opens in a new browser tab (the CAPTCHA service's privacy policy and terms, the server's terms on the registration form). Keep the brackets so that it reads apart from the link's name.

auth.mail_unsubscribe.done_title.description: Title and heading of the page after an unsubscribe link stopped its emails.

auth.mail_unsubscribe.invalid.defaultMessage: Este enlace no es válido. Puede que haya caducado. Puedes dejar de recibir los correos en tus preferencias.
auth.mail_unsubscribe.invalid.description: Error when an unsubscribe link is unknown or expired. Must not say which.

auth.mail_unsubscribe.submit.description: Button that stops the emails of an unsubscribe link.

auth.mail_unsubscribe.title.description: Title and heading of the page that the unsubscribe link of a notification email opens.

auth.reset_password.done.defaultMessage: Tu contraseña se ha cambiado y se ha cerrado toda sesión que usaba la anterior. Inicia sesión con la contraseña nueva.
auth.reset_password.done.description: Body of the page after a new password was set from a reset link.

auth.reset_password.done_title.description: Title and heading of the page after a new password was set from a reset link.

auth.reset_password.invalid.defaultMessage: Este enlace no es válido. Puede que haya caducado, que ya se haya usado o que lo haya sustituido una contraseña más reciente. Solicita un enlace nuevo.
auth.reset_password.invalid.description: Error when a password reset link is unknown, expired, used, or older than the current password. Must not say which.

auth.reset_password.password_label.description: Label of the new password field of the page that a password reset link opens.

auth.reset_password.prompt.defaultMessage: Elige una contraseña nueva. Al establecerla se cerrarán tus sesiones en todas partes. Tus llaves de acceso y la autenticación en dos pasos no cambian.
auth.reset_password.prompt.description: Text above the form that sets a new password from a reset link.

auth.reset_password.submit.description: Button that sets the new password from a reset link.

auth.reset_password.title.description: Title and heading of the page that a password reset link opens.

auth.sign_in.email_label.description: Label of the email address field on the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.failed.defaultMessage: El correo electrónico o la contraseña no son correctos.
auth.sign_in.failed.description: Error after a failed sign-in. Must not say which of the two was wrong, so that it does not reveal whether an account exists.

auth.sign_in.forgot_password_link.description: Link from the sign-in form to the page that asks for a password reset link.

auth.sign_in.missing.defaultMessage: Introduce tu correo electrónico y tu contraseña.
auth.sign_in.missing.description: Error when the sign-in form was submitted with an empty field.

auth.sign_in.passkey.defaultMessage: Iniciar sesión con una llave de acceso
auth.sign_in.passkey.description: Button on the sign-in page that signs in with a passkey (WebAuthn) instead of the email address and password. Shown only in browsers that support passkeys.

auth.sign_in.passkey_cancelled.defaultMessage: No se usó la llave de acceso. Inténtalo de nuevo o inicia sesión con tu correo electrónico y tu contraseña.
auth.sign_in.passkey_cancelled.description: Alert on the sign-in page when the browser's passkey prompt was dismissed or failed before anything was sent to the server.

auth.sign_in.passkey_expired.defaultMessage: El inicio de sesión con llave de acceso tardó demasiado. Inténtalo de nuevo.
auth.sign_in.passkey_expired.description: Alert on the sign-in page when the passkey sign-in was answered after it expired (5 minutes) or was already used.

auth.sign_in.passkey_failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo verificar la llave de acceso. Prueba con otra o inicia sesión con tu correo electrónico y tu contraseña.
auth.sign_in.passkey_failed.description: Alert on the sign-in page when the server could not verify the passkey (unknown or removed passkey, wrong signature) or its account cannot sign in.

auth.sign_in.password_label.description: Label of the password field on the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.rate_limited.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {Demasiados intentos fallidos de inicio de sesión. Inténtalo de nuevo dentro de # minuto.} other {Demasiados intentos fallidos de inicio de sesión. Inténtalo de nuevo dentro de # minutos.}}
auth.sign_in.rate_limited.description: Error (HTTP 429) after too many failed sign-ins from the same network or for the same email address. {minutes} is the wait, rounded up to whole minutes.

auth.sign_in.sign_up_link.description: Link from the sign-in page to the registration page; hidden while registration is closed.

auth.sign_in.submit.description: Button that submits the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.title.description: Title and heading of the sign-in page.

auth.sign_out.submit.description: Button that ends the current browser session.

auth.sign_up.agreement.defaultMessage: Lee estos documentos de este servidor antes de crear una cuenta.
auth.sign_up.agreement.description: Notice above the links to the instance's terms of service and privacy policy (only those it has published) on the registration form, followed by the checkbox that agrees to them.

auth.sign_up.agreement.label.defaultMessage: He leído y acepto los documentos anteriores
auth.sign_up.agreement.label.description: Label of the required checkbox under the links to the instance's terms of service and privacy policy on the registration form.

auth.sign_up.agreement.required.defaultMessage: Acepta los documentos anteriores para crear una cuenta.
auth.sign_up.agreement.required.description: Error under the agreement checkbox of the registration form when the form was sent without it.

auth.sign_up.closed.defaultMessage: Este servidor no acepta cuentas nuevas.
auth.sign_up.closed.description: Body of the registration page while the server accepts no new accounts.

auth.sign_up.email_hint.description: Hint under the email address field of the registration form.

auth.sign_up.email_invalid.defaultMessage: Introduce un correo electrónico como alice@example.com.
auth.sign_up.email_invalid.description: Error under the email address field when it is not a plain address.

auth.sign_up.email_label.description: Label of the email address field on the registration form.

auth.sign_up.email_taken.defaultMessage: Este correo electrónico ya está en uso.
auth.sign_up.email_taken.description: Error under the email address field when another account uses the address.

auth.sign_up.error_summary.defaultMessage: No se creó la cuenta. Revisa los campos marcados más abajo.
auth.sign_up.error_summary.description: Alert at the top of the registration form when one or more fields need fixing; each field shows its own error.

auth.sign_up.invite_hint.defaultMessage: Este servidor solo acepta cuentas nuevas por invitación.
auth.sign_up.invite_hint.description: Hint under the invite code field, while the server accepts sign-ups by invitation only.

auth.sign_up.invite_hint_optional.defaultMessage: Si alguien te invitó, introduce el código de invitación. También puedes registrarte sin él.
auth.sign_up.invite_hint_optional.description: Hint under the optional invite code field, while the server accepts sign-ups without an invite.

auth.sign_up.invite_hint_approval.defaultMessage: Si alguien te invitó, introduce el código de invitación: tu cuenta se podrá usar de inmediato, sin esperar a la revisión. También puedes registrarte sin él.
auth.sign_up.invite_hint_approval.description: Hint under the optional invite code field, while new accounts wait for a moderator's review unless the applicant has an invite.

auth.sign_up.invite_invalid.defaultMessage: Este código de invitación no es válido. Puede que haya caducado o que ya se haya agotado.
auth.sign_up.invite_invalid.description: Error under the invite code field when the code is unknown, expired, revoked, used up, or of a member who can no longer invite. Must not say which.

auth.sign_up.invite_label.description: Label of the invite code field of the registration form, required while the server accepts sign-ups by invitation only and optional otherwise.

auth.sign_up.invite_required.description: Error under the invite code field when it is empty.

auth.sign_up.password_hint.description: Hint under the password field. {min} and {max} are the allowed lengths in characters.

auth.sign_up.password_invalid.defaultMessage: Usa de {min, number} a {max, number} caracteres.
auth.sign_up.password_invalid.description: Error under the password field when it is too short or too long. {min} and {max} are the allowed lengths in characters.

auth.sign_up.password_label.description: Label of the password field on the registration form.

auth.sign_up.rate_limited.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {Demasiados intentos de registro desde tu red. Inténtalo de nuevo dentro de # minuto.} other {Demasiados intentos de registro desde tu red. Inténtalo de nuevo dentro de # minutos.}}
auth.sign_up.rate_limited.description: Error (HTTP 429) after too many sign-ups from the same network. {minutes} is the wait, rounded up to whole minutes.

auth.sign_up.reason_hint.defaultMessage: Un moderador revisa las cuentas nuevas antes de que se puedan usar. Hasta {max, number} caracteres.
auth.sign_up.reason_hint.description: Hint under the reason field. {max} is the longest allowed answer in characters.

auth.sign_up.reason_invalid.description: Error under the reason field when the answer is too long. {max} is the longest allowed length in characters.

auth.sign_up.reason_label.description: Label of the free-text field asking why the applicant wants to join, shown when sign-ups need a moderator's approval.

auth.sign_up.refused.defaultMessage: Este servidor no puede aceptar este registro.
auth.sign_up.refused.description: Error (HTTP 403) when the sign-up block list or the external review refuses the sign-up. It deliberately does not say why.

auth.sign_up.submit.description: Button that submits the registration form.

auth.sign_up.title.description: Title and heading of the registration page.

auth.sign_up.username_hint.defaultMessage: Hasta {max, number} letras (a–z), dígitos y guiones bajos. No se puede cambiar después.
auth.sign_up.username_hint.description: Hint under the username field. {max} is the longest allowed username in characters.

auth.sign_up.username_invalid.defaultMessage: Usa de 1 a {max, number} letras (a–z), dígitos y guiones bajos.
auth.sign_up.username_invalid.description: Error under the username field when it has characters other than a–z, digits, and underscores, or is too long. {max} is the longest allowed length.

auth.sign_up.username_label.description: Label of the username field on the registration form.

auth.sign_up.username_taken.defaultMessage: Este nombre de usuario ya está en uso.
auth.sign_up.username_taken.description: Error under the username field when another account has the username.

auth.signed_in.continue.description: Link on the signed-in page back to where the user was going.

auth.signed_in.title.description: Title and heading of the page shown when a signed-in user opens the sign-in page.

auth.status.action_deletes_in.defaultMessage: {days, plural, one {Tu cuenta se eliminará dentro de # día} other {Tu cuenta se eliminará dentro de # días}}
auth.status.action_deletes_in.description: When a ban deletes the user's account, in place of its end, on the page of a signed-in user whose account is restricted. {days} is the time left, rounded up to whole days.

auth.status.action_active.description: Badge next to a moderation action on the user's account that is in effect, on the status page of a signed-in user whose account is restricted. The account status page of the app says the same.

auth.status.appeal_state_label.defaultMessage: {state, select, pending {En revisión} upheld {Acción mantenida} overturned {Acción levantada} other {Apelada}}
auth.status.appeal_state_label.description: Badge with where the user's appeal of a moderation action stands, on the status page. {state} is pending, upheld (the action stays), or overturned (the action is lifted). The account status page of the app uses the same words.

auth.status.action_ends_in.defaultMessage: {days, plural, one {Termina dentro de # día} other {Termina dentro de # días}}
auth.status.action_ends_in.description: When a moderation action on the user's account ends, on the page of a signed-in user whose account is restricted. {days} is the time left, rounded up to whole days.

auth.status.action_reason.description: The reason category of a moderation action, on the page of a signed-in user whose account is restricted. {category} is the category's label (for example, Spam).

auth.status.action_until_lifted.defaultMessage: Dura hasta que un moderador la levante
auth.status.action_until_lifted.description: Says that a moderation action on the user's account has no end date, on the page of a signed-in user whose account is restricted.

auth.status.appeal_answer.description: Label before the moderators' explanation of their decision on the user's appeal, on the status page of a signed-in user whose account is restricted.

auth.status.appeal_hint.defaultMessage: {days, plural, one {Puedes apelar una sola vez, en un plazo de # día. Hasta {max, number} caracteres.} other {Puedes apelar una sola vez, en un plazo de # días. Hasta {max, number} caracteres.}}
auth.status.appeal_hint.description: Hint under the appeal field of a moderation action on the status page. {days} is the time left to appeal, rounded up to whole days; {max} is the longest allowed appeal in characters.

auth.status.appeal_label.description: Label of the field in which a user whose account is restricted writes their appeal of a moderation action (why a moderator should reconsider it).

auth.status.appeal_not_sent.defaultMessage: No se envió la apelación. Revisa el campo marcado más abajo.
auth.status.appeal_not_sent.description: Alert on the status page when the appeal form was sent with an empty or too long appeal; the field's own error follows below.

auth.status.appeal_sent.defaultMessage: Se envió tu apelación. Un moderador la revisará.
auth.status.appeal_sent.description: Notice on the status page after the user appealed a moderation action on their account.

auth.status.appeal_state.defaultMessage: {state, select, pending {Tu apelación está a la espera de la revisión de un moderador.} upheld {Un moderador revisó tu apelación y mantuvo la acción.} overturned {Un moderador revisó tu apelación y levantó la acción.} other {Apelaste esta acción.}}
auth.status.appeal_state.description: Where the user's appeal of a moderation action stands, on the status page. {state} is pending, upheld (the action stays), or overturned (the action is lifted).

auth.status.appeal_submit.description: Button that sends the user's appeal of a moderation action on their account. The account status page of the app says the same.

auth.status.appeal_text_invalid.defaultMessage: Escribe tu apelación en un máximo de {max, number} caracteres.
auth.status.appeal_text_invalid.description: Error under the appeal field when it is empty or too long. {max} is the longest allowed appeal in characters.

auth.status.pending.defaultMessage: Tu registro está a la espera de la aprobación de un moderador. Puedes iniciar sesión, pero solo podrás usar la aplicación cuando se apruebe.
auth.status.pending.description: Explains that a moderator has not yet approved the registration and that the app cannot be used until then.

auth.status.rejected.defaultMessage: Tu registro no se aprobó, así que no se puede usar esta cuenta.
auth.status.rejected.description: Tells a signed-in user that a moderator rejected their registration.

auth.status.resend_failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo enviar el correo. Inténtalo de nuevo más tarde.
auth.status.resend_failed.description: Error when the confirmation email could not be sent (for example, the mail server is down).

auth.status.resend_rate_limited.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {Has solicitado el enlace demasiadas veces. Inténtalo de nuevo dentro de # minuto.} other {Has solicitado el enlace demasiadas veces. Inténtalo de nuevo dentro de # minutos.}}
auth.status.resend_rate_limited.description: Error (HTTP 429) after the user asked for the confirmation link too often. {minutes} is the wait, rounded up to whole minutes.

auth.status.resend_submit.description: Button that sends the email confirmation link again.

auth.status.resent.defaultMessage: Hemos enviado un enlace nuevo a {email}.
auth.status.resent.description: Notice after the confirmation link was sent again. {email} is the user's email address.

auth.status.restricted.defaultMessage: Un moderador ha tomado medidas sobre tu cuenta, así que no puedes usar la aplicación. Estas acciones están en vigor:
auth.status.restricted.description: Explains to a signed-in user that moderation actions (login disabled, suspension) keep them out of the app; the list of the actions follows.

auth.status.restricted_title.description: Title and heading of the page a signed-in user sees while a moderation action keeps their account out of the app.

auth.status.title.defaultMessage: Tu cuenta aún no está lista
auth.status.title.description: Title and heading of the page a signed-in user sees while their account cannot be used yet (waiting for approval or email confirmation, or rejected).

auth.status.verify_email.defaultMessage: Confirma tu correo electrónico: abre el enlace que enviamos a {email}.
auth.status.verify_email.description: Asks the user to open the confirmation link. {email} is their email address.

auth.status_page.link.description: Text of the link to the instance's status page (ADR-0088) in the footer of the server-rendered pages, shown only when the operator set status_page_url.

auth.two_factor.code_label.description: Label of the code field on the second step of signing in, which takes a six-digit code of an authenticator app or a recovery code.

auth.two_factor.expired.defaultMessage: El inicio de sesión tardó demasiado. Inicia sesión de nuevo.
auth.two_factor.expired.description: Error on the sign-in form when the second step (the authentication code) was not completed within five minutes or was already used.

auth.two_factor.invalid.defaultMessage: El código es incorrecto o ya se usó.
auth.two_factor.invalid.description: Error on the second step of signing in when the authentication code or recovery code is wrong or was used before.

auth.two_factor.missing.description: Error when the authentication code form was submitted empty.

auth.two_factor.prompt.defaultMessage: Introduce el código de seis dígitos que muestra tu aplicación de autenticación. Si no puedes usar la aplicación, introduce uno de tus códigos de recuperación.
auth.two_factor.prompt.description: Text above the code field on the second step of signing in, for users who turned on two-factor authentication.

auth.two_factor.restart_link.description: Link from the second step of signing in back to the sign-in form, to start over.

auth.two_factor.submit.description: Button that submits the authentication code on the second step of signing in.

auth.two_factor.title.description: Title and heading of the second step of signing in, which asks for an authentication code.

auth.verify_email.done.defaultMessage: Gracias. Tu correo electrónico está confirmado.
auth.verify_email.done.description: Body of the page after the email address was confirmed.

auth.verify_email.done_title.description: Title and heading of the page after the email address was confirmed.

auth.verify_email.invalid.defaultMessage: Este enlace no es válido. Puede que haya caducado o que ya se haya usado. Inicia sesión para obtener uno nuevo.
auth.verify_email.invalid.description: Error when a confirmation link is unknown, expired, or already used. Must not say which.

auth.verify_email.prompt.defaultMessage: Selecciona el botón de abajo para confirmar tu correo electrónico.
auth.verify_email.prompt.description: Text above the button that confirms the email address.

auth.verify_email.submit.description: Button that confirms the email address.

auth.verify_email.title.description: Title and heading of the page that a confirmation email links to.

auth.authorize.scope.read_voice.defaultMessage: Leer las salas de chat de voz que puedes ver
auth.authorize.scope.read_voice.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:voice) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_voice.defaultMessage: Abrir salas de chat de voz, unirte a ellas, salir y organizarlas
auth.authorize.scope.write_voice.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:voice) listed on the authorization page.

auth.external.heading.description: Heading above the buttons of the sign-in and registration pages that sign in with another service (an external login provider) that the server's administrators set up.

auth.external.github.button.description: Text of the button on the sign-in and registration pages that signs in with GitHub (a login provider of kind github that the server's administrators set up).

auth.external.discord.button.description: Text of the button on the sign-in and registration pages that signs in with Discord (a login provider of kind discord that the server's administrators set up).

auth.external.unavailable.defaultMessage: Esta forma de iniciar sesión no está disponible.
auth.external.unavailable.description: Error page when the user opens the sign-in of an external login provider that does not exist or is turned off.

auth.external.failed.defaultMessage: No se completó el inicio de sesión con el otro servicio. Inténtalo de nuevo o inicia sesión de otra forma.
auth.external.failed.description: Alert on the sign-in page when the external login provider did not complete the sign-in: the user cancelled it, or the service answered an error.

auth.external.expired.defaultMessage: El inicio de sesión tardó demasiado o ya se usó. Empieza de nuevo.
auth.external.expired.description: Alert on the sign-in page when the sign-in with an external login provider (or the account creation after it) expired or was used already.

auth.external.denied.defaultMessage: Este servidor no acepta esa cuenta del otro servicio.
auth.external.denied.description: Alert on the sign-in page when the account at the external login provider does not meet the conditions that the administrators set (such as an organization).

auth.external.heading_only.description: Heading above the buttons of the sign-in and registration pages while only those services sign in: there is no form above them, so it has no "or".

auth.external.not_linked.defaultMessage: Ninguna cuenta de este servidor está vinculada a esa cuenta del otro servicio. Inicia sesión de otra forma.
auth.external.not_linked.description: Alert on the sign-in page when no account is linked to the account at the external login provider and new accounts cannot be created with it.

auth.external.sign_up.title.description: Title of the registration page for an account at an external login provider. {provider} is the provider's name as the administrators wrote it.

auth.external.sign_up.email_hint.defaultMessage: Recibirás correos en esta dirección. Te enviaremos un enlace para confirmarla.
auth.external.sign_up.email_hint.description: Hint under the email address on the registration page of an account at an external login provider, when the provider did not confirm the address.

auth.external.sign_up.email_verified.defaultMessage: {provider} confirmó esta dirección. Si la cambias, te enviaremos un enlace para confirmar la nueva.
auth.external.sign_up.email_verified.description: Hint under the email address on the registration page of an account at an external login provider, when the provider confirmed the address. {provider} is the provider's name.

auth.external.other_user.defaultMessage: Este enlace es para otra cuenta. Cierra sesión, inicia sesión con esa cuenta e inténtalo de nuevo.
auth.external.other_user.description: Error page when the browser that opens the link or confirmation of an account at an external login provider is signed in as another user than the one who started it.

auth.forgot_password.login_providers_onl.defaultMessage: Este servidor solo permite iniciar sesión mediante proveedores de inicio de sesión, así que aquí no se pueden restablecer contraseñas. Si tu cuenta no tiene ninguno vinculado, consulta a los administradores.
auth.forgot_password.login_providers_onl.description: Replaces the form that asks for a password reset link, and answers it, while the instance limits sign-in to login providers. It is the same for every address.

auth.mail_unsubscribe.done.defaultMessage: Ya no recibirás correos de las notificaciones de «{group}». Puedes volver a activarlos en la configuración de notificaciones.
auth.mail_unsubscribe.done.description: Body of the page after an unsubscribe link stopped the emails of a kind of notification. {group} is the name of the kind, as the notification settings name it (such as Mentions).

auth.mail_unsubscribe.prompt.defaultMessage: ¿Dejar de recibir correos de las notificaciones de «{group}»? Seguirán apareciendo en la aplicación.
auth.mail_unsubscribe.prompt.description: Text above the button that stops the emails of a kind of notification, on the page of their unsubscribe link. {group} is the name of the kind, as the notification settings name it (such as Mentions).

auth.reset_password.login_providers_only.defaultMessage: Este servidor solo permite iniciar sesión mediante proveedores de inicio de sesión, así que este enlace no puede establecer una contraseña ahora. Si tu cuenta no tiene ninguno vinculado, consulta a los administradores.
auth.reset_password.login_providers_only.description: Error page of a password reset link while the instance limits sign-in to login providers. It is the same whether or not the link works.

auth.sign_in.login_providers_only.defaultMessage: Este servidor solo permite iniciar sesión mediante proveedores de inicio de sesión. Si tu cuenta no tiene ninguno vinculado, consulta a los administradores.
auth.sign_in.login_providers_only.description: Note on the sign-in page, and the refusal of a sign-in with a password or a passkey, while the instance limits sign-in to login providers. It is the same for every account.

auth.sign_up.login_providers_only.defaultMessage: Este servidor solo registra usuarios nuevos mediante proveedores de inicio de sesión.
auth.sign_up.login_providers_only.description: Note on the registration page, and the refusal of a registration with a password, while the instance limits registration to login providers.

auth.status.deactivated_title.description: Title of the page that a user who deactivated their account sees after signing in.

auth.status.deactivated.defaultMessage: Desactivaste esta cuenta, así que está oculta para todos y no recibe nada.
auth.status.deactivated.description: Explains to a signed-in user that they deactivated their account and what that means.

auth.status.deactivated_deletion.defaultMessage: Se eliminará el {date} a menos que la reactives.
auth.status.deactivated_deletion.description: States when the deactivated account is deleted. {date} is the date and time with its time zone, such as 2026-12-03 09:00 (UTC).

auth.status.deactivated_reactivate.description: Label of the button that brings back a deactivated account.

auth.status.deactivated_reactivate_hint.defaultMessage: Tus publicaciones, seguidos y seguidores están como los dejaste. Lo que se te envió mientras tanto no llega, y hay que volver a autorizar las aplicaciones.
auth.status.deactivated_reactivate_hint.description: Hint under the button that brings back a deactivated account.

auth.status.deactivated_delete_heading.description: Heading of the form that deletes a deactivated account at once.

auth.status.deactivated_delete_hint.defaultMessage: No se puede deshacer. Tus publicaciones y tu cuenta desaparecen, y tu nombre de usuario no se volverá a usar nunca.
auth.status.deactivated_delete_hint.description: Hint of the form that deletes a deactivated account.

auth.status.deactivated_password_label.description: Label of the field that confirms the deletion of a deactivated account.

auth.status.deactivated_delete.description: Label of the button that deletes a deactivated account.

auth.status.deactivated_expired.defaultMessage: Ha pasado la fecha para reactivar esta cuenta y se está eliminando.
auth.status.deactivated_expired.description: Alert when a user tries to reactivate an account after the date of its deletion.

auth.status.deactivated_wrong_password.description: Alert when the password that confirms the deletion of a deactivated account is wrong.

auth.status.deactivated_sign_in_again.defaultMessage: Para confirmar la eliminación, cierra sesión, inicia sesión de nuevo y elimina la cuenta.
auth.status.deactivated_sign_in_again.description: Alert when a user without a password deletes a deactivated account in a session that started too long ago.

auth.status.deleted_title.description: Title of the page after a user deleted their deactivated account.

auth.status.deleted.defaultMessage: Tu cuenta y tus publicaciones han desaparecido, y se ha avisado a otros servidores.
auth.status.deleted.description: Message of the page after a user deleted their deactivated account.
